headline: Khaitan & Co advises Vector Line Capital $75 million investment in Tessolve Semiconductor
sum: Vector Line Capital has made an investment of $75 million in Tessolve Semiconductor Private Limited. Khaitan & Co advised Vector Line Capital on this investment.
detail: Vector Line Capital has made an investment of $75 million in Tessolve Semiconductor Private Limited. Khaitan & Co advised Vector Line Capital on this investment. The core team consisted of Kapish Mandhyan (Partner), Reshma Abraham (Counsel), Deep Shah (Principal Associate), Aanya Desai (Associate) and Krisha Devani (Associate). The following provided support: Funds: Divaspati Singh (Partner), Khusboo Agarwal (Counsel), Samarth Chopra (Senior Associate) and Parv Pancholi (Associate); Tax: Rahul Jain (Partner), Jinisha Jain (Senior Associate), Krishnal Shailesh Agrawal (Associate) and Krunal Himanshu Mehta (Associate); and Antitrust: Anshuman Sakle (Partner), Alisha Mehra (Principal…
